# Requirements Quality Checklist: Change-Proposal Structure

**Purpose**: Validate the requirements added by the second amendment (FR-028 to FR-037, SC-016 to SC-021, User Story 5) for completeness, clarity, consistency and testability
**Created**: 2026-09-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

These requirements govern the content of a **prose artifact**, which is the hardest kind to write testable requirements for. So the sharpest question throughout is not "does the requirement say what the artifact should contain?" but **"does it say what would make the artifact wrong?"** A requirement naming a section that must be present can fail a check. A requirement asking for wording that is clear, helpful or appropriately brief cannot, and items below single those out rather than letting them pass as requirements.

## Testability of Prose-Artifact Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Does FR-029's "in a form a reviewer can read before opening the proposed difference" state any condition under which the requirement is unmet? [Measurability, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the difference between a requirement about a structure's **content** and one about its **wording quality** drawn anywhere in the amendment, so a later reader can tell which requirements are checkable? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 For each of FR-028 to FR-037, can a reader name the artifact state that fails it? [Measurability, Spec §FR-028 to §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the two questions FR-032 mandates specified precisely enough that two people would agree whether a given structure asks them? [Clarity, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK005 Does any requirement in the amendment depend on a reviewer's judgement of tone, length or helpfulness without saying so? [Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK006 Is there a requirement bounding how much a structure may ask, given that an artifact long enough to be skipped fails its purpose while satisfying every content requirement? [Gap]

## Governance Citation: Which Obligation, and How Verified

- [ ] CHK007 Does FR-030 identify **which** obligation is to be quoted, or only that an obligation is? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK008 Does FR-031 identify which principles a review is obliged to verify, or leave the set to be determined at implementation time? [Completeness, Spec §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "source location" defined to a granularity two implementers would agree on — document, section, or line? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030, §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK010 Does FR-036's "detectable by running something" name what runs, where it lives, or what it exits with? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-036]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it stated whether FR-036's detection is part of the aggregate check or separate from it, given that SC-018 is only automatically verifiable if it is part of it? [Gap, Spec §FR-036, §SC-018]
- [ ] CHK012 Does any requirement say what happens when the governance document is amended and a quotation goes stale — who updates it, and before what? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the versioned nature of the governance document accounted for, so a quotation can be tied to the version it was taken from rather than only to a location? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Do FR-030 and FR-031 require quotation **verbatim**, or would an accurate paraphrase satisfy them as written? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030, §FR-031]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 Do FR-031 and FR-035 overlap? Both require the reviewer be pointed at the principles a review must verify, and it is not stated which one governs if they diverge. [Conflict, Spec §FR-031, §FR-035]
- [ ] CHK016 Is FR-035's "section addressed to the reviewer" the same artifact element as FR-031's identification of principles, or two separate elements? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-031, §FR-035]
- [ ] CHK017 Are FR-033's prohibition and SC-019's count stated in terms that can disagree — one about obligations "required by FR-030 or FR-031", the other about "obligations counted by SC-017"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-033, §SC-017, §SC-019]
- [ ] CHK018 Does the amendment use one term throughout for the artifact — "proposal structure" — without drifting into synonyms elsewhere in the spec? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK019 Is FR-037's "no check's declared scope MAY change" consistent with the existing FR-013a requirement that each check declare its own skipped paths? [Consistency, Spec §FR-037, §FR-013a]
- [ ] CHK020 Does Out of Scope's exclusion of automatic check reporting contradict FR-030, which requires the author to state a check result the repository cannot verify? [Consistency, Spec §FR-030]

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK021 Is it specified what a proposal states under FR-034 when no session reference exists — a human-typed change, or an agent whose session is not linkable? [Gap, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for a change spanning both specialised kinds at once, given that only one structure can be selected? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK023 Is it stated whether the general structure's content is required in a proposal that selected a specialised structure, or merely permitted to be duplicated there? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for the case where the aggregate check has not been run at all, as distinct from run and failed? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK025 Does any requirement address a proposal that is a draft or work in progress, where the check obligation has not yet come due? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the audience of each structure specified — which parts the author fills in and which the reviewer reads? [Completeness, Spec §FR-035]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK027 Is any success criterion defined for FR-029, or is "states what changed and why" uncounted? [Gap, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK028 Is any success criterion defined for FR-034's agent-authorship requirement? [Gap, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK029 Can SC-018's "0 statements contradict" be evaluated without a defined procedure for comparing a quotation to its cited location? [Measurability, Spec §SC-018]
- [ ] CHK030 Does SC-021's "0 additional structures ask only questions the general one already asks" state how overlap is determined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-021]
- [ ] CHK031 Is SC-016's "applied without the author selecting it" verifiable by this repository, or does it assert a behaviour of a system outside it? [Measurability, Spec §SC-016]
- [ ] CHK032 Are all six new criteria technology-agnostic, consistent with the existing criteria they are numbered alongside? [Consistency, Spec §SC-016 to §SC-021]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK033 Are the three acceptance scenarios in User Story 5 each traceable to at least one of FR-028 to FR-037? [Traceability, Spec §User Story 5]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the exception flow covered — an author who deletes a section — with a requirement, or only with an edge-case note and an assumption? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the recovery flow covered — what corrects a proposal that arrived without the structure — or is it intentionally excluded? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK036 Does the amendment state which of its requirements are unenforceable by this repository, so a reader does not mistake an obligation for a guarantee? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK037 Is the assumption that exactly one structure is applied automatically stated as a property of the hosting surface rather than as a design preference, and is it traceable to evidence? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the dependency on the governance document's stability documented, given that FR-036 couples the structures to its wording? [Dependency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK039 Are the two specialised kinds in FR-032 justified against the repository's actual change kinds, or asserted? [Assumption, Spec §FR-032]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK015 and CHK020 are the two items most likely to be real defects rather than questions: the first is an apparent duplication between FR-031 and FR-035, the second a tension between FR-030 and an Out of Scope entry. Both were noticed while writing this checklist and neither has been resolved in the spec
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
